name: rich-style-cascade-policies
instr:
Give callers an opt-in, inspectable style cascade that applies named precedence policies across Rich rendering while distinguishing semantic output roles. Cascaded rendering must preserve existing geometry, segment structure, controls, metadata, links, ordering, and terminal output whenever no cascade applies.

`CascadeMode`, `StyleLayer`, `StyleCascade`, and `cascaded` are public from `rich.style_cascade`; ordered layers resolve immutably by mode and role without mutating inputs. `StyleRole` is public from `rich.style_roles`, and its closed role family is ALL, CONTENT, PADDING, BORDER, TITLE, GUIDE, and PLACEHOLDER; only matching layers affect a role. `StyleConflict`, `CascadeResult`, and `CascadeReport` are public from `rich.style_report`; every explicit replacement records stable layer identities, role, attribute, and values in composition order. `CascadeReport.add` aggregates immutable observations in rendering order, `CascadeReport.for_role` filters them, and repeated reads never duplicate them. Every printable segment, wherever produced or nested, composes its own style through the cascade while control segments remain exempt. Align, Styled, Padding, Panel, Rule, Layout, Tree, Progress, and LiveRender classify their generated decoration and child content semantically while preserving established measurement, expansion, truncation, alignment, terminators, boundaries, and traversal order.
